title: Where Is the Tree? A Rectangle Puzzle | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A tree stands on the edge of a yard, exactly as far from one corner as from another. Vantee finds it two ways: testing the choices with the Pythagorean theorem, and naming the distance x and solving.
She also shows why each wrong answer is tempting, then gives you a bigger yard to try yourself.
